concepts.name: Turing machines and tapes
concepts.gloss: Basic Turing machines with tapes, heads and finite alphabets.

concepts.name: Fixed multitape Turing machine model
concepts.gloss: Deterministic Turing machine with a fixed finite alphabet and a fixed finite number of one-dimensional tapes; cost is the number of steps.

concepts.name: Schönhage–Strassen n log n optimality conjecture
concepts.gloss: Schönhage and Strassen proposed n log n as optimal growth for multiplying n-bit integers on multitape machines; Harvey–van der Hoeven reached O(n log n).

evidence.quote: proposed $n\log n$ as the optimal order of growth

concepts.title: Optimality conjecture for $n\log n$ multiplication

symbols.name: input length
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in each input integer.

concepts.name: Multiplication as convolution of digit lists
concepts.gloss: Splitting inputs into radix digits turns integer multiplication into convolution of short integer coefficient lists, with carries propagated afterwards.

evidence.quote:
Splitting the inputs into radix digits reduces multiplication to
convolution of short integer coefficients.

concepts.name: Discrete Fourier transform
concepts.gloss: Evaluation of a sequence at powers of a root of unity; it turns cyclic convolution into pointwise product.

evidence.quote: The vector norm is the maximum modulus of its coordinates.

concepts.name: Multidimensional transform
concepts.gloss: A Fourier transform on an array with several axes, applied along each axis in turn; here axis lengths are powers of two.

evidence.quote:
multidimensional transforms whose axis lengths are
powers of two

concepts.name: Polynomial ring modulo y^r + 1
concepts.gloss: Complex polynomials in y reduced modulo y^r+1, so y^r=-1; coefficients stored as a list, with r a power of two.

symbols.name: ring degree

concepts.name: Synthetic polynomial transform
concepts.gloss: Fourier transform over the polynomial ring where powers of y act as roots of unity, so multiplying by a root is a signed shift of the coefficient list (Nussbaumer).
